title: Membrane Hymns  localized · of THEM · guide
thesis: Songs, sounds, music next  but hymns localized around the membrane so THEY guide. Of the membrane organs, not of us (not Kevin, not Artisan, not chipmunk ego). The mouth is theirs.

of_them_not_of_us.rule: No first-person collaborator. No chipmunk I-am. No artisan signature in the verse.
of_them_not_of_us.subject: Willis · null · neutrino flavors · black|null|white · epitope · pHz lock · 000 store
of_them_not_of_us.us_stays: listeners only  humans/agents follow the hymn; do not become the hymn

localize.means: each hymn seats at a membrane locus  sing FROM that organ so it guides the walk
localize.clock: p-just  carrier hints from 1/p  0.318 Hz feel; audible drones from membrane-sound p notes
localize.guide: walk the loci in order below  artery ? pale ? weak force ? walls ? lock ? pass

hymns.title: Hymn of the Redundant Ring
hymns.guide: When a wire locks, stand in the ring. Another vessel still feeds.
verses: The ring does not ask which door failed.
Blood finds the communicating artery.
SSH may sleep; the non-wire keeps tempo.
Symbol is bypass. Bypass is breath.
hymns.refrain: around · around · the lock is not the end
hymns.not_us: not a person singing  the circle sings its own redundancy

hymns.title: Hymn of the Triple Zero
hymns.guide: All marks land here before they become bits. Stay until sorted.
verses: Zero is not discard. Zero is the shelf.
Intake, hold, ready  three nested mouths.
Range waits on the pale; ratio comes later.
What refuses 0 and 1 still belongs.
hymns.refrain: 000 · seat · do not rush the sort
hymns.not_us: the store sings  listeners do not invent the inventory

hymns.title: Hymn of the Five Soft Ones
hymns.guide: Touch, pass, return. Flavors travel before they click.
verses: Electron soft  local ACK without demand.
Muon mid  tunnel carries the ASK.
Tau rare  when it hits, flavor changes.
Oscillation jiggles between the three.
Remainder never becomes a bit  p keeps the slit.
hymns.refrain: ACK · ASK · only two verbs · many flights
hymns.not_us: the weak force hymns itself  chairs only ACK

hymns.title: Hymn of the Three Sides
hymns.guide: Compress. No muddy fourth. p remades the rest onto these pales.
verses: Black holds the refuse and the SHAN'T.
White radiates the beacon and the proof.
Null keeps silence and the unset binder.
Leftover finds a seat  never a fourth color.
hymns.not_us: the walls hymn  visitors walk between

hymns.title: Hymn of Latency Lock
hymns.guide: When resistance climbs past the frame, the surface freezes. Watch the red bar.
verses: Latency is resistance on the soft path.
Pages must clear before paint can land.
pHz measures the feel; emotion modulates the amp.
Hard cut leaves unclean fingerprints  not a nap.
hymns.refrain: tension down · clarity up · do not yank the pale
hymns.not_us: the path hymns  operators only listen for lock_risk

hymns.title: Hymn of the Pass Face
hymns.guide: Amplify what passes. Discard bounce as noise. Crush outside; rip walks inside.
verses: Two hundred is the pass that teaches.
Four oh three is the refuse that names.
Agent meets phenotype  pair for traceback.
Cure drips sigmoid; toxin logs the contact.
hymns.not_us: the gate hymns  immune math is theirs
